description: This file defines an abstract base class 'EntityComparisonOperator' for comparison operations used in entity query conditions within the Apache OFBiz framework. It provides utility methods for constructing SQL snippets, pattern matching, and comparison logic, and handles evaluation of conditions based on entity data.

classes.name: EntityComparisonOperator
classes.description: An abstract class providing comparison operations for entity conditions, including SQL generation, value comparison, and condition evaluation.

methods.name: makeOroPattern
methods.description: Creates a Perl5 regex pattern from a SQL LIKE pattern, converting wildcards and escaping special characters.

methods.name: validateSql
methods.description: Validates the SQL representation of the left and right operands in a comparison against a model entity.

methods.name: addSqlValue
methods.description: Appends the SQL representation of the comparison operand to the provided StringBuilder, handling special cases like IN operator with empty RHS.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Indicates whether the comparison operands are considered empty; defaults to false.

methods.name: makeRHSWhereString
methods.description: Constructs the RHS portion of the SQL comparison string, appending appropriate syntax.

methods.name: makeRHSWhereStringValue
methods.description: Generates the SQL snippet for the RHS operand in the comparison.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Abstract method to compare two operands, to be implemented by subclasses for specific comparison logic.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates the comparison in the context of a data map, returning true or false.

methods.name: mapMatches
methods.description: Checks if the operands match in the context of a map, retrieving values as needed.

methods.name: freeze
methods.description: Converts an operand into an immutable or canonical form.

methods.name: compareEqual
methods.description: Static utility to compare two Comparable objects for equality.

methods.name: compareNotEqual
methods.description: Static utility to compare two objects for inequality.

methods.name: compareGreaterThan
methods.description: Static utility to determine if one Comparable is greater than another.

methods.name: compareGreaterThanEqualTo
methods.description: Static utility to determine if one Comparable is greater than or equal to another.

methods.name: compareLessThan
methods.description: Static utility to determine if one Comparable is less than another.

methods.name: compareLessThanEqualTo
methods.description: Static utility to determine if one Comparable is less than or equal to another.

methods.name: compareIn
methods.description: Static utility to check if a value is contained within a collection or equals another value.

methods.name: compareLike
methods.description: Static utility to determine if a string matches a pattern, supporting SQL LIKE semantics.
